title: Reserves
key_points: Reserves are a critical concept in the XRP Ledger, representing trust accounts that hold XRP and other assets.
Each account in the XRP Ledger has a reserve associated with it, which can be used to settle payments.
The total amount of reserves in the ledger is always equal to or greater than the total amount of XRP in all account balances.
Reserve accounts are managed by the XRPL protocol and cannot be accessed directly by users.
Reserves play a crucial role in maintaining the stability, decentralization, and trustlessness of the XRP Ledger.
limitations: The documentation does not cover technical details or implementation specifics of reserves.
It provides an overview from a conceptual standpoint rather than diving into intricate technical aspects.
asserts: Reserves are essential in the XRP Ledger, ensuring the stability and trustlessness of the system through decentralized account management.
